manual_notes: Evofosfamide was investigated in phase II trials for soft tissue sarcoma.
HSA is serum albumin rather than X linked hydrocephalus.
Peripheral neuropathy was an exclusion criterion rather than a pemetrexed target.
Hydrogen peroxide altered integrin expression in promyelocytic leukemia.
Calcitriol reduced glioblastoma cell growth in vitro.
Rosiglitazone and hepatitis C appeared in covariate lists.
Urokinase was a positive control in a rat cerebral ischemia model.
ALS is a plant disease context rather than amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
10 hydroxycamptothecin inhibited esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth in models.
HBsAg based immunization attenuated Alzheimer model progression.
Ellagic acid altered metabolism in endometrial cancer cells.
Cefotaxime treated pneumonia in a patient with HIV.
CCL5 and SCD are gene or enzyme contexts rather than cefaclor and Schnyder disease.
Potassium supplementation may be required in proximal renal tubular acidosis.
TMP SMX prevented infections in neutropenic patients rather than treating neutropenia.
Pazopanib combination therapy was evaluated for fallopian tube cancer.
Mibefradil was studied for arrhythmias induced by myocardial ischemia.
Calcium supplemented osteopenia in premature newborns with growth restriction.
SDS is a rating score rather than Shwachman Diamond syndrome.
Phloroglucinol derivatives were proposed against HIV not HIV associated nephropathy.
Bryostatin ameliorated experimental colitis in mice.
Palbociclib suppressed B cell lymphoma cell lines at high concentrations.
Telmisartan plus 5 FU reduced muscle atrophy in a model.
AMI is not acute motor axonal neuropathy in this aloe vera animal study.
AHA is the American Heart Association rather than acetohydroxamic acid.
Mefloquine was suggested as a candidate for cervical cancer treatment.
Lobaplatin arrested cell cycle progression in HCC cells.
Calcium alginate supplement efficiency was studied in viral hepatitis patients.
Hesperidin was only indirectly proposed for vitreous degeneration strategies.
PCP means primary care physician rather than phencyclidine.
TNT means total neoadjuvant therapy rather than trinitrotoluene.
BMD is bone mineral density rather than Becker muscular dystrophy.
HDAC inhibitors showed synergy across sarcoma cell lines.
Myricetin showed potential protection against cataract formation.
Locally applied isosorbide decreased bone resorption in rat periodontitis.
Tamoxifen reduced extracellular matrix proteins in scleroderma fibroblast cultures.
Tandutinib plus bevacizumab was registered to treat recurrent brain tumors.
Sotagliflozin trials were extended to type 2 diabetes.
Alogliptin treatment showed benefit against early diabetic nephropathy.
Nebivolol likely treated hypertension while rosuvastatin treated hyperlipidemia.
IPS is intermittent photic stimulation rather than ichthyosis prematurity syndrome.
GAD1 deficiency is not generalized anxiety disorder.
Adenosine affected signaling in Graves disease thyroid tissue.
Magnesium oxide nanoflakes were drug carriers for generic cancer therapy.
Adenosine receptor biology suggested targets but the normalized subject is a nucleotide residue.
Amphotericin B was in a broad nanoformulation list not specific cardiovascular therapy.
PCD is programmed cell death rather than primary ciliary dyskinesia.
IHH is infantile hepatic haemangioma rather than hemiconvulsion hemiplegia syndrome.
Everolimus managed refractory meningioma but pediatric specificity is not shown.
Prazosin was included among therapies for renal hypertension.
